translations.literal: Liu Yanlang, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau and assigned Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Commissioner of the Southern Bureau and assigned Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yanlang, Northern Bureau commissioner and Bureau of Military Affairs vice commissioner, was made Southern Bureau commissioner and Bureau of Military Affairs vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以左僕射李愚卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On bingchen, court was suspended for the death of Li Yu, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen court was suspended for the death of Li Yu, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，幸崇道宮、甘泉亭。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dingmao, the Emperor visited the Chongdao Palace and Sweet Spring Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on dingmao the Emperor visited the Chongdao Palace and Sweet Spring Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以左衛上將軍李頃為左領軍上將軍。

translations.literal: On jisi, Li Qing, General of the Left Guard, was made General of the Left Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Li Qing, General of the Left Guard, was made General of the Left Army.

sentences.zh: 北面行營總管石敬瑭奏，自代州歸鎮。

translations.literal: Shi Jingtang, overall commander of the Northern Front camp, memorialized that he had returned from Dai Prefecture to his command.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jingtang, Northern Front camp overall commander, reported that he had returned from Dai Prefecture to his command.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以晉州節度使張溫卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On gengwu, court was suspended for the death of Zhang Wen, military commissioner of Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu court was suspended for the death of Zhang Wen, Jin Prefecture military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸趙延壽、張延朗第。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Emperor visited the residences of Zhao Yanshou and Zhang Yanlang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Emperor visited the residences of Zhao Yanshou and Zhang Yanlang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以端明殿學士、兵部侍郎李專美為秘書監，充宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Li Zhuanmei, Academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of War, was made Director of the Secretariat and assigned as Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Zhuanmei, Duanming Hall academician and Vice Minister of War, was made Director of the Secretariat and Northern Bureau commissioner of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以左諫議大夫唐汭為左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Tang Rui, Left Remonstrance Counselor, was made Left Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Tang Rui, Left Remonstrance Counselor, was made Left Regular Attendant.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，以左驍衛上將軍郝瓊為左金吾上將軍，以光祿卿王玟為太子賓客。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi, Hao Qiong, General of the Left Xiaoqi Guard, was made General of the Left Golden Guard; Wang Min, Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, was made Guest of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengzi Hao Qiong, General of the Left Xiaoqi Guard, was made General of the Left Golden Guard; Wang Min, Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, was made Guest of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 以徐州節度使張敬達為晉州節度使，依前充大同、振武、威塞、彰國等軍兵馬副總管。

translations.literal: Zhang Jingda, military commissioner of Xu Prefecture, was made military commissioner of Jin Prefecture, continuing as before as deputy overall commander of the horse-and-foot forces of the Datong, Zhenwu, Weisai, Zhangguo, and other armies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jingda, Xu Prefecture military commissioner, was made Jin Prefecture military commissioner, continuing as before as deputy overall commander of the horse-and-foot forces of the Datong, Zhenwu, Weisai, Zhangguo, and other armies.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以秘書少監丁濟為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Ding Ji, Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Ding Ji, Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以前金州防禦使馬全節為滄州留後。

translations.literal: On yimao, Ma Quanjie, former defense commissioner of Jin Prefecture, was made acting military commissioner of Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Ma Quanjie, former Jin Prefecture defense commissioner, was made acting commander of Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：劉延朗欲除全節絳州刺史，群議沸騰。

translations.literal: (The 《Comprehensive Mirror》: Liu Yanlang wished to appoint Quanjie prefect of Jiang Prefecture, and opinion among the officials seethed.)
translations.idiomatic: (Per the 《Comprehensive Mirror》: Liu Yanlang wished to appoint Quanjie prefect of Jiang Prefecture, and court opinion seethed.)

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，以為橫海留後。）〉

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard of it, he made him acting commissioner of the Henghai command.)〉
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor heard of it, he made him acting commissioner of the Henghai command.)〉

sentences.zh: 渤海國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The state of Bohai sent envoys to present tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Bohai sent envoys to present tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，禁用鉛錢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, the use of lead coin was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, the use of lead coin was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以中書侍郎兼兵部尚書、充樞密使韓昭裔為檢校司空、同平章事，充河中節度使。

translations.literal: On renshen, Han Zhaoyi, Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of War and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made honorary Minister of Works, Associate Counselor, and military commissioner of Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Han Zhaoyi, Vice Director of the Chancellery, concurrent Minister of War, and Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner, was made honorary Minister of Works, Associate Counselor, and Hezhong military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以宗正少卿李延祚為將作監致仕。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Li Yanzuo, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Clan, was made Director of Palace Buildings and retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Yanzuo, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Clan, was made Director of Palace Buildings and retired from office.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，故武安軍州節度使、累贈太傅劉建峰贈太尉，從湖南之請也。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Liu Jianfeng, late military commissioner of the Wu'an Army and repeatedly posthumously advanced to Grand Tutor, was posthumously advanced to Grand Marshal, acceding to a request from Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Liu Jianfeng, late Wu'an commander and repeatedly posthumously advanced to Grand Tutor, was posthumously made Grand Marshal at Hunan's request.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太常奏：「來年正月一日上辛，祀昊天上帝於圓丘，依禮大祠不朝。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: "On the first shangxin day of the first month of next year, the Supreme God of the Vast Heaven will be sacrificed to at the Round Mound; according to ritual, on great sacrifices there is no court audience.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "On the first shangxin day of the first month of next year, the Supreme God of the Vast Heaven will be sacrificed to at the Round Mound; according to ritual, great sacrifices preclude a court audience.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「祀事在質明前，儀仗在日出後，事不相妨，宜依常年受朝。

translations.literal: " An edict stated: "The sacrifice takes place before dawn, while the ceremonial guard forms after sunrise; the two do not interfere with each other. The annual court audience should be held as usual.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict read: "The sacrifice takes place before dawn, while the ceremonial guard forms after sunrise; the two do not interfere. The annual court audience should be held as usual.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，以翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎程遂為兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: " On renwu, Cheng Sui, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War;
translations.idiomatic: " On renwu Cheng Sui, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War;

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、工部侍郎崔棁為戶部侍郎；

translations.literal: Cui Yuan, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuan, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Revenue;

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、中書舍人和凝為工部侍郎，並依前充職。

translations.literal: He Ning, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works—all retaining their concurrent posts as before.
translations.idiomatic: He Ning, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works—all retaining their concurrent posts as before.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以前秘書監楊凝式為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Yang Ningshi, former Director of the Secretariat, was made Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Yang Ningshi, former Director of the Secretariat, was made Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以前同州節度使馮道為司空，以尚書右僕射劉煦為左僕射，以太子少師盧質為右僕射，以兵部侍郎馬縞兼國子祭酒。

translations.literal: On jichou, Feng Dao, former military commissioner of Tong Prefecture, was made Minister of Works; Liu Xu, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director; Lu Zhi, Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Right Vice Director; Ma Gao, Vice Minister of War, was made concurrent Rector of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Feng Dao, former Tong Prefecture commander, was made Minister of Works; Liu Xu, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director; Lu Zhi, Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Right Vice Director; Ma Gao, Vice Minister of War, was made concurrent Rector of the Directorate of Education.
